blocks.text: Buying a Detached House in the City of Langley, BC

parts.t: The
City of Langley
is a compact 10.2-square-kilometre municipality independent from the surrounding Township of Langley, bordered by 196 Street (the
Surrey / Cloverdale

boundary) to the west, 210 Street to the east, 62 Avenue to the north, and 44 Avenue to the south. Separated by the Nicomekl River floodplain and trail network, the City pairs an urban downtown core and future 196 Street and 203 Street SkyTrain stations north of the river with established single-family residential neighbourhoods south of the river.

blocks.text: South of the Nicomekl: Alice Brown, Simonds & Uplands

parts.t: South of the Nicomekl River, neighbourhoods around Alice Brown Elementary, Simonds Elementary, and Uplands Elementary feature 1960s–1980s ranchers, split-levels, and two-storey single-family homes on 6,000 to 10,000+ sq ft rectangular and cul-de-sac lots, along with quarter-acre RS2 parcels toward 44 Avenue.

East of 200 Street between the Nicomekl River and 48 Avenue, the Blacklock and Douglas neighbourhoods offer walkable access to Douglas Park, Portage Park, HD Stafford Middle School, and downtown Fraser Highway shops.

With two Surrey-Langley SkyTrain stations arriving at 196 Street and 203 Street on Fraser Highway, lots north of the Nicomekl River and within Transit-Oriented Areas carry high-density redevelopment designations, while single-family lots south of the river fall under City of Langley Official Community Plan and SSMUH infill rules.

blocks.text: City of Langley Houses for Sale — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What is the difference between the City of Langley and the Township of Langley?

The City of Langley and the Township of Langley are two separate municipalities with independent mayors, councils, zoning bylaws, property tax rates, and engineering departments. The City of Langley covers the 10.2 sq km urban core between 196 Street and 210 Street, while the Township of Langley surrounds the City on the north, east, and south (including Willoughby, Walnut Grove, Brookswood, Murrayville, Aldergrove, and Fort Langley).
Which neighbourhoods in the City of Langley have the most detached houses?

Most detached single-family homes in the City of Langley sit south of the Nicomekl River in the Alice Brown, Simonds, Uplands, and Blacklock catchments (between 53 Avenue and 44 Avenue), where 6,000 to 10,000+ sq ft residential lots predominate.
Where are the future City of Langley SkyTrain stations located?

The 16-kilometre Surrey-Langley SkyTrain extension along Fraser Highway includes two stations inside the City of Langley: 196 Street Station (Willowbrook) and the terminus 203 Street Station (Langley City Centre).
Are secondary suites and garden suites permitted in the City of Langley?

Yes. City of Langley RS1 and RS2 residential zones allow registered secondary suites inside single-family homes as well as detached garden suites / coach houses on qualifying lots, subject to lot coverage, parking, and building-permit requirements.
How does BC Bill 44 (SSMUH) affect single-family lots in the City of Langley?

Under provincial Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing legislation, qualifying single-family residential lots in the City of Langley are eligible for 3 to 4 residential units (and up to 6 units near qualifying frequent-transit stops), subject to municipal servicing, floodplain, and tree bylaws.
Which public schools serve the City of Langley?

Both the City of Langley and the Township of Langley share Langley School District 35 (SD35). City of Langley catchments include Simonds Elementary, Alice Brown Elementary, Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary, Uplands Elementary, Douglas Park Community Elementary, Nicomekl Elementary, HD Stafford Middle School, and Langley Secondary School.
Do City of Langley houses have municipal water and sewer?

Yes. Unlike rural acreages in South Brookswood or rural Township areas that rely on wells and septic fields, residential subdivisions within the City of Langley are connected to municipal water and sanitary sewer services.
